title: The Acropolis
subtitle: Standing above Athens, where ancient history and our own journey came together.
summary: Our visit to one of the world's most recognizable ancient landmarks.
heroImageAlt: The Acropolis and Parthenon above Athens

sections.heading: A Citadel Above Athens
paragraphs: The Acropolis is a fortified hill that has watched over Athens for thousands of years.
Walking through the site brought us face-to-face with one of the most important landmarks of the ancient world.

highlights.title: The Parthenon
highlights.description: The centerpiece of the Acropolis and one of the world's most influential buildings.

highlights.title: The Erechtheion
highlights.description: Known for the Porch of the Caryatids.

tips.title: Go early
tips.description: Earlier admission generally provides cooler temperatures and smaller crowds.

tips.title: Wear proper shoes
tips.description: The marble and stone pathways can be uneven and slippery.

resources.title: Acropolis Visitor Information
resources.description: Review current visitor information, ticket details and site guidance before planning a visit.

resources.title: Acropolis Museum
resources.description: Explore the museum collection and learn more about the archaeological discoveries from the Acropolis.
